scripts.test: pnpm test:addon && pnpm run test:js && pnpm test:companion
scripts.test:addon: cd addon && luacheck . && lua5.1 tests/run.lua && lua5.1 tests/data.lua && lua5.1 tests/ui.lua && lua5.1 tests/forever.lua && lua5.1 tests/recipe-sources.lua && lua5.1 tests/quest-sightings.lua && lua5.1 tests/skill-route.lua
scripts.test:js: pnpm exec vp test && pnpm --filter @unbored/web test
scripts.lint:companion: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/companion/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/companion/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --no-default-features -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/companion/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @unbored/web typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint:js && (cd addon && luacheck .) && pnpm run lint:companion
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @unbored/server build && pnpm --filter @unbored/companion build && pnpm --filter @unbored/web build
